data.rationale: The proposed steps follow the true sequence in the right order: Careers, Openings, the Country, Team and Time Type filters, Search, then open a job and apply. Two things are off. The final job action is marked optional and has no parameter for which job to open or whether to apply or save it. The spec also adds keyword and location parameters that the true workflow never uses.
